body: Just wanted to add that I have a use case for rendering an existing vnode in the template.  I'm building a DataTable component where my api, for example returns a list of table headers. Each object contains a "render" function that returns already created vnode. Unfortunately, Dynamic component is the only "official" way to render existing vnode inside of SFC and without workaround posted above, it doesn't work as it should - [example](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)

Seems like a bug, definitely. The new subtree is present in the instance's vnode, but DOM wasn't patched:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1444526/140480788-991274f3-e01f-46d9-b20e-0357ea6f8c7f.png)

Actually, it's a bug. should not take fast path when dynamicChildren is empty.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3705199/140487457-f354eec2-8239-40a9-9c85-aa730a21622d.png)

the root cause is we doesn't track block here.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3705199/140494331-98e4c88e-15ba-4879-9316-0fea9b105680.png)

body: @edison1105 while this issue is still open. Do you know why I also can't render a Fragment which may have falsy values as its children? Will your PR fix this case? [check example](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#). It works in plain JS though

@sqal 
this code not working because component should be a vnode not an vnode array.
```javascript
  const array = () => [
    h('div', 'foo'),
    h('div', 'bar')
  ]
```
should change to
```javascript
  const array = () =>  h(Fragment,null,[
    h('div', 'foo'),
    h('div', 'bar')
  ])
```

this code not working because  every item in children array must be a  vnode.
```javascript
    return h(Fragment, null, [
      h('div', 'foo'),
      // ERROR: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'el')
    	null,
      //false,
      h('div', 'bar'),
    ])
```

@sqal 
A vnode is the result of template compilation. If you want to create a vnode with the h function, you have to make sure it is correct and can be rendered into the DOM.

issue.body:
### Vue version 3.3.1 ### Link to minimal reproduction [https://play.vuejs.org](https://play.vuejs.org/#) ### Steps to reproduce Click on button. ### What is expected? Template should update to show ``` str-add str-add ``` ### What is actually happening? Only str outside of div update to show "str-add". That is: ``` str str-add ``` ### Any additional comments? In the `space.vue` file, the child in the template is calculated using slots.default(). The content of the first child is`
{{str}}
`, and when it's passed to component:is, the ShapeFlags is marked as -1, which prevents it from being updated. I'm not sure if this is a bug or if this approach is unsupported. If I wrap the child with the h function, there is no issue with updating. ``` ``` [https://play.vuejs.org/](https://play.vuejs.org/#) There is already a similar issue([#4903 ](https://github.com/vuejs/core/issues/4903)) that has been resolved, but this one is slightly different.
